stem: During a systematic crop-observation route, a technician finds direct pest evidence concentrated near one intake. What response best preserves useful evidence and biosecurity boundaries?
choices: Record only the pest name and continue the route without location context
Record the identified locations, incidence/severity or counts and direct evidence, protect the affected movement/biosecurity boundary, and escalate as required by procedure
Treat the whole room immediately without authorization
Remove the affected leaves and omit the finding so the room record stays consistent
rationale: The technician preserves direct crop-observation evidence, spatial context and biosecurity controls while escalating within the supplied procedure. A visible finding does not authorize independent treatment selection.

extensions.revisionNote: Remapped from integrated objective 04 to objective 02 because the item primarily measures systematic crop observation, evidence collection, biosecurity and escalation. Propagation/canopy integration remains represented by items 007 and 008 under objective 04.
